verdicts.explanation: Sample 19 (25:14:61) is reported in Table 2 and the abstract as 4.9 × 10-4 S/cm at 300 °C, measured in this paper. The solid-state synthesis method and null secondary fields are consistent with the paper, and the quote is verbatim.

Table 1 lists sample 7 (25, 0, 75) at 1.6 × 10-4 S/cm, measured at 300 °C as stated in the Table 1 caption and Section 2. The Section 3.1 sentence containing the quote links sample 7 to 1.6 × 10-4 S/cm, and the data are from this paper's own experiments.
